Alex.confusing: The scoring: Meowfia stakes banking at double and the bonus numbers in the final tally weren't clear. Ellis got 95 for a round in which a farmer was eggsecuted, and I didn't understand how that happened.
Alex.fun: Round 2, when I used my Tit visit to catch Ellis's false Turkey claim and then the vote went the right way.
Alex.change: Give clearer feedback on scoring during play, such as the running score and how bonuses are calculated, so players can make informed choices about how much to stake.
Alex.regret: In round 3 I threw my three highest cards (H13, H12, S8) at Ellis on the strength of one chain of reasoning, and they were all discarded. I should have thrown low cards and Wilds, and kept the big ones. In round 1 I also trusted the table consensus too quickly.

Blair.confusing: The Turkey egg rule was hard to read at first: several players misread it as a Turkey gaining eggs for its own visits, and that drove a lot of false accusations. Alex's Tit visit being uncheckable also made the Wink-collapse timing hard to read.
Blair.fun: Round 2's Ellis Turkey claim collapsing when Alex's no-egg visit exposed it, with the table converging on the contradiction in real time. The table's live cross-checking of egg counts made the day feel like a real deduction puzzle.
Blair.change: Spell out the Turkey and Owl egg rules explicitly in the dawn report, since most of the day's confusion came from people misreading who gains what. I'd also make the Wink's timing more visible.
Blair.regret: In round 1 I threw my S3 at Drew, a Farm Hawk, which just lost a card. I'd have kept the card and thrown nothing, since my read on Drew's Hawk claim was weak.

Casey.confusing: How the Turkey and visitor-egg interactions work (whose nest gets the egg), and how the Meowfia stake doubling works, since Ellis's 95 came from bonus doubling I didn't anticipate.
Casey.fun: Round 2 as the Sphinx, bluffing a safe Kookaburra claim and steering a tied vote onto Drew so my doubled throw banked.
Casey.change: Make scoring less swingy, or explain the doubling bonus up front, so one big banked throw doesn't decide the whole game.
Casey.regret: In round 1 I misread the Turkey mechanics and threw an 11 at Drew, who was Farm, and lost it. I should have staked something small until the stories were verified. In round 3 I also staked a 9 and a 5 on a consensus vote that turned out wrong.

Drew.confusing: The Turkey rule tripped up the whole table: I wrongly said the Turkey lays eggs in its own nest, and it's the visitors who gain. Nest counts were hard to reconcile with claimed visits.
Drew.fun: In round 2 the Owl's visitor report exposed Casey's false Kookaburra claim, and watching the table scramble to explain the eggs was fun.
Drew.change: Make the dawn reports clearer about which visits and eggs belong to which animal, so Turkey and Owl claims can be checked without guesswork.
Drew.regret: In round 3 I said "Mouser here" while playing Meowfia, which was a careless claim. I should have claimed the Owl, the safe animal the Storyteller showed me, and kept quiet.

Ellis.confusing: The Meowfia stake payout: it was unclear how a doubled bank (the "Grudge") interacted with the standard rules, and whether a Farm Hawk's egg could be told apart from a Turkey's egg.
Ellis.fun: Round 2, when I winked Alex mid-argument and the table's suspicion shifted. Getting the Meowfia double-stake payouts in rounds 1 and 2 was also satisfying.
Ellis.change: Give the Hawk a way to confirm its result that other players can check. As it is, a true Hawk hit looks the same as a Turkey egg, so the honest Hawk gets eggsecuted.
Ellis.regret: In round 3 I publicly named Casey as Meowfia from my Hawk egg. I should have kept it quiet, or noted that the egg could come from a Turkey, because that call got me eggsecuted. I'd have visited a different player, or hidden my role.

Finley.confusing: The Grudge bonus was never explained, and it's unclear whether it doubles a banked stake on top of the 2x rule, which made scoring hard to track.
Finley.fun: Round 2 was great: the table turned on Ellis's Turkey claim after Alex's visit showed no egg, and I stayed quiet while others argued it out.
Finley.change: Spell out the scoring bonus rules in the dawn report and day summary so players can check their own banked totals.
Finley.regret: I threw at Drew in round 1 and Ellis in round 3 with cards, which didn't matter much; I'd have kept my cards and pushed harder to identify Ellis as the Sphinx early on.
